actions.name: create.new_brief
actions.says: Start a brief in Create and its first round of options: Create writes the headlines (always in English) and one idea per picture, then makes the pictures with OpenAI. The brief is ready when its options are made.

name.description: the brief's name, as the team would call it

ages.description: the age of the people the ads speak to, e.g. 55-75

images.description: how many pictures to make, 0 to 12; 6 when left out

headlines.description: how many headlines to write, 0 to 30; 10 when left out. Not both 0

own_headlines.description: headlines the person gave, in English, to keep and to learn from

extra.description: anything else the person asked for

id.description: a Spy ad's id (as in tracks.ads) or a library creative's id, as text

actions.costs: Paid to OpenAI: the headlines and each picture. A brief's cost_usd says what it spent; OpenAI credit is short, so ask for no more pictures than the person needs.

actions.name: create.save_set
actions.says: Save chosen options of a ready brief into the library as one set, which Launch then makes ads from. Every option must be the brief's and done.

args.name: ai_label
args.says: the person's answer for the pictures: marked as made by AI (ai, as Create's page does by default), not_ai, or unset. Ask the person when they have not said

actions.returns: the save's id; create.saves shows its library_set_id once it is saved

actions.name: create.briefs
actions.says: Briefs and where each stands: draft, reading, making, ready (options to choose from) or failed (error says why), with what it asked for and what it cost.

actions.name: create.options
actions.says: The options made for briefs: pictures (kind image; image_url once done) and headlines (kind headline, text), with the angle each tries and the person's marks (chosen, starred).

actions.name: create.saves
actions.says: Saves of chosen options into the library: waiting, saving, done or failed, and the library set once it exists (Launch opens it at /launch/new?set=<library_set_id>).
